object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Over MCP, define an enumeration attribute with required and options; a text attribute; a text attribute with a label; one attribute of each of the kinds integer, real, boolean and date; and a required text attribute with a default value. Expected: each call succeeds and the manifest, or show_document, holds each attribute with the given kind, options and label; the default value is set on the existing object.
